SAP Advanced Therapy Orchestration
/content/sapdx/countries/en_us/registration/request-demo.html

Streamline advanced therapies with end-to-end supply chain orchestration

Orchestrate advanced therapies with chain of identity and chain of custody tracking, flexible batch handling, ERP integration, quality checks, and real-time control of the therapy supply chain.

Benefits

  • Streamline patient-specific supply chains

    Support the complete end-to-end orchestration of individualized therapies, ensuring accurate and timely coordination of patient-specific treatment journeys.

  • Improve compliance and traceability

    Enable full chain of identity (COI) and chain of custody (COC) tracking, ensuring regulatory compliance and facilitating audit and documentation processes.

  • Accelerate time to market

    Facilitate integration with manufacturers, logistics, treatment centers, and ERP systems (SAP/non-SAP) via event-driven data sharing and real-time task management. Configurable settings support multiple therapies.

  • Improve operational efficiency with automation

    Automate synchronization of orders, shipments, and related S/4HANA objects between SAP Advanced Therapy Orchestration and SAP S/4HANA, reducing manual effort and minimizing errors.

  • Increase agility and resilience

    Provide proactive exception and task management to handle disruptions, deviations, and supply chain changes without compromising quality or timelines.

Features

View media gallery

Manage each step of supply chain orchestration

The solution automates the coordination of patient-specific processes, from biospecimen collection to final therapy delivery.

Integrate with external partners and logistics providers

Enable role-specific task access and collaboration for contract development and manufacturing organizations while supporting logistics handoffs and courier bookings.

Enable label management for flexible batch handling

Integrate labels with existing printing systems. Support complex batch and sub-batch allocation, reallocation, and validation, along with dynamic material handling.

Manage tasks and exceptions

Users can proactively manage exceptions, delays, and task assignments, ensuring visibility and control over deviations in patient supply chains.

Integrate with SAP S/4HANA out of the box

Using prepackaged events and APIs, the solution supports third-party ERP systems through standardized event-driven interfaces. It can also operate as a standalone orchestration layer with full visibility and control.

Track COI and COC across systems

Maintain patient–product integrity and compliance across the supply chain while supporting the generation of audit trails and traceability reports.
